verdict.rationale: Mercury directly claims accounting sync with QuickBooks, Xero and NetSuite plus "AI-powered automations to close your books faster" (mercury-docs-6). Related first-party features support this: AI bill reading and auto-population (mercury-docs-3), automatic receipt matching to card transactions (mercury-docs-5), and API/MCP write actions for categorizing transactions and uploading receipts (mercury-docs-29, mercury-docs-12). However, the evidence is marketing-level only. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on what the close automations actually do (e.g., auto-categorization rules, reconciliation, sync behavior), and independent or hands-on corroboration that month-end close is actually faster.
